sources.locator: § 4 ust. 2 pkt 2: 5 points per ha for "Międzyplony ozime lub wsiewki śródplonowe"; § 6: winter cover crop mix of at least two species, or a small-seeded legume undersown; załącznik nr 2 część II pkt 2: sown 1 July to 1 October, kept until 15 February

sources.locator: § 3 ust. 1: 87,52 zł per point; § 3 ust. 2: points coefficient 0,887902 for "Zróżnicowana struktura upraw" (2025). 3 x 0.887902 x 87.52 = 233.13 PLN/ha. No regulation with the rates for 2026 was found in the Sejm ELI database on 14 Nov 2026, so the 2025 rate is used and marked unconfirmed

sources.locator: § 4 ust. 2 pkt 5: 3 points per ha; § 8 ust. 2: at least three crops, one with a positive effect on soil organic matter (załącznik nr 5, wykaz nr 1); załącznik nr 5 wykaz nr 2 (cereals) and nr 3 (crops with a negative effect: beet, potato)

sources.locator: § 1 pkt 12 (załącznik nr 2 część II pkt 5): largest crop at most 65% of arable land, wykaz nr 1 crops at least 20%, wykaz nr 2 cereals at most 65%, wykaz nr 3 crops at most 30%
